scope_statement: This package covers exactly one imported molecular object, MMFold_1, and the MMetrics/auto-compute tasks the platform ran on it. No structure was re-predicted, no external structure (5GRJ / 7XYQ / 5JDS) was downloaded or used as a model, and no other project or task was touched.

mos_object_download (GetMOSObject, sanit.path: input/MMFold_1.cif (downloaded copy kept as the single package input copy)

hashes.interpretation: The declared source SHA256, the MOS-sanitized object served by GetMOSObject, and the session copy are byte-identical. For this import the sanitization step changed no bytes, so 'raw input hash' and 'sanitized input hash' are the same value; the file already carried the MOS layout (_mos_mapping, P 1 cell, _entry.id 342254287430656_model_sample_1) when it entered the session.

sequence_verification.method: sequence-toolkit store --length + Biopython BLOSUM62 local alignment vs UniProt Q9NZQ7

chain_A.construct_artifacts: leading Met (residue 1) and trailing LE (residues 117-118) outside the UniProt span

chain_B.framework4: WGQGTQVTVSS (hallmark of camelid VHH, CH1 absent)
chain_B.note: no light chain in the structure, consistent with a single-domain binder

sections_empty_verbatim.model_tasks.results: [] (no MutX / AbAn / AbScN / ParaDt model output produced)

sections_absent: protein domain annotation (no feature with annotation_type 'domain')
PTM annotation (no feature with annotation_type ptm/glycosylation/phosphorylation)
no separate 'Homologs' boolean section; homology is annotations.homology (3 hits) and annotations.uniprot is empty
native_inconsistencies_noted: annotations.homology entries carry entity_id=1 but their query/aligned sequence is chain B (the VHH) - entity tagging error in the native output, left unmodified.

classification.reasoning states '51 contacts' while interactions.2d_plot_data[0].meta.n_contacts is 44 and the contact list holds 44 entries; the reasoning text is not reconciled with the numeric block.

annotations.pdb lists 5JDS / 4DKA / 4DK3 and annotations.homology hit pdb|5JDS|B at identity 1.0. These are native pipeline reference hits only. They were NOT downloaded, opened, or used as a model for any analysis in this package; 5JDS/7XYQ/5GRJ were excluded per instruction.

mutation_token_verification.conclusion: The auto-compute mutation tables are internally consistent with the structure numbering: 4674 = 118x19 + 128x19 affinity rows, every wild-type letter matches the residue at that index, and each position carries exactly 19 non-native substitutions.

independent_tasks.note: No independently launched MOS task exists for this structure; the platform task list held only the two auto tasks.

performed_here: SHA256 comparison of declared vs registered vs session copy
BLOSUM62 local alignment of chain A/B vs UniProt Q9NZQ7 (sequence-identity check only)
decoding and validating mutstr tokens against structure residues
local_analysis.note: No local structural or energetic recomputation (no re-fold, no docking, no ddG). Local work is limited to identity, numbering and token decoding checks.
